components.name: Finite precision-genesis, history-collision, locality-obstruction, hierarchy-geometry, and falsification layer
components.project_addition: Combines canonical Enterprise Math integer-scale, correspondence, collision, future-safe quotient, intrinsic-geometry, and falsification surfaces into a finite precision-genesis research layer. WIP results prove monotonicity of the full binomial history-collision spectrum and merge excess under serial state-extensional relational branching, decompose every spectrum increase into nonnegative branch-copy and cross-source collision terms, and give exact branching/occupied/merge accounting. Negative boundaries show that deterministic towers, finite rational stochastic branching, and finite adaptive interventions over finite rational classical kernels admit finite latent/pre-sampled completions. A partial positive obstruction is obtained only after adding independently testable structure: setting-local response functions plus measurement-setting-independent latent weights obey an exact integer CHSH bound, while a rational Pythagorean singlet target has |S|=14/5 and is therefore outside that completion class. This is a finite specialization/use of Bell/CHSH prior art, not a new Bell theorem; nonlocal or measurement-dependent completions remain residual. Separately, a deterministic pre-sampled seed supporting every m-step r-ary response string needs at least r^m distinguishable seed states, making finite initial latent capacity an explicit resource restriction. Nested refinement signatures induce a divisibility-weighted integer ultrametric; connected leaf geometry additionally requires cross-fiber bridge witnesses. Connecting every immediate child quotient needs exactly |X|-1 witness edges and this is sharp, but different minimal witness choices still produce different diameters, so hierarchy plus minimal connectivity does not determine macroscopic geometry. A threshold-record P016 submodel derives eta=max(d-delta,0)/d from integer record dynamics rather than treating eta as free; the Pedalino representative lower visibility gives the toy algebraic exclusion 100*delta>91*d, with no claim of apparatus calibration or confidence-level exclusion. The underlying combinatorics, finite probability/functional representation, causal-intervention semantics, Bell/CHSH locality theory, graph/tree/ultrametric geometry, quantum cosmology, decoherence, and interferometry literature are established prior art; historical novelty of the synthesis and exact cross-surface collision-spectrum formulation remains unverified.
